alert_news.title: Chhattisgarh launches India's first official state hockey league
bullets: India’s first official state-level hockey league, the Chhattisgarh Hockey League (CHL), inaugurated in Raipur at the Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel International Hockey Stadium under Hockey India and the Sports and Youth Welfare Department of Chhattisgarh.
The league features six franchise teams, runs from 21 Oct to 1 Nov 2026, and follows a round‑robin format with semifinals and a final.

alert_news.title: Uttarakhand to set up India's first Agniveer Employment Cell for jobs, schemes
bullets: India's first dedicated Agniveer Employment Cell, announced by the Uttarakhand state government, to link former Agniveers with government jobs, schemes and self‑employment opportunities
Located in Uttarakhand; provides 10% reservation, age relaxation and priority recruitment for ex‑servicemen, marking the inaugural employment‑transition cell for Agniveers in the country

alert_news.title: India’s first Olympic skeet shooter
bullets: First Indian skeet shooter to qualify for the Olympics, representing India at Rio 2016 and Tokyo 2020
First Indian skeet shooter to win an ISSF World Cup medal (silver 2016) and gold (2022)

alert_news.title: India’s first construction technology expo, conference and awards platform
bullets: India’s first construction technology expo, conference and awards platform – The ConTech Show 2026, held at Bombay Exhibition Centre, Mumbai
Integrated architects, builders, developers, startups, banks and technology companies to promote adoption of AI, BIM, robotics and digital twins in construction

alert_news.title: First Indian woman to win COSPAR medal
bullets: First Indian woman to receive the COSPAR Vikram Sarabhai Medal, awarded by COSPAR and ISRO at the 46th COSPAR Scientific Assembly, Florence, Italy
The medal honors outstanding contributions to space research; she is the third woman overall to receive it

alert_news.title: Made in Amethi: India's first 100% indigenous AK-203 Sher is ready for its biggest test
bullets: India's first fully indigenised AK-203 "Sher" assault rifle, manufactured at the IRRPL Korwa facility in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh, under the Ministry of Defence.
All components and raw materials sourced domestically; production target of 150,000 rifles per year with a prototype every 100 seconds, marking a historic self‑reliance milestone.

alert_news.title: India’s First Solar-Powered ‘Algae Trees’ Installed In Bhopal
bullets: India's first solar-powered algae trees installed in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh
Algae trees use solar energy to produce biofuel and purify water
Installed by local authorities as part of green initiative

alert_news.title: India’s First 100% Indigenous AK-203 Sher Assault Rifle
bullets: India's first fully indigenous AK-203 Sher assault rifle manufactured at IRRPL's Korwa facility in Amethi
All components sourced domestically, marking end-to-end indigenisation
Prototype completed firing tests, ready for Indian Army trials

alert_news.title: India's first successful landing on the Moon's south polar region by Chandrayaan‑3
bullets: India's first successful lunar landing on the Moon's south polar region by ISRO's Chandrayaan‑3 Vikram Lander on 23 August 2023
Landing site named Shiv Shakti; marks India's inaugural landing on the Moon's south polar region

alert_news.title: India Plans Bharatiya Antariksha Station by 2035
bullets: India’s first space station, Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS), planned by ISRO, 52‑tonne, low‑Earth orbit 400‑450 km, 5 modules.
First module BAS‑01 approved by the Union Cabinet, cost ₹1,763 crore, development scheduled 2025‑2028.
BAS is part of the Gaganyaan human spaceflight programme, designed to support a crew of 3‑4 astronauts for 3‑6 months.

alert_news.title: India Approves First Module of Bharatiya Antariksha Station – India's First Space Station
bullets: India’s first space station, Bharatiya Antariksha Station (BAS), approved by the Union Cabinet; first module BAS‑01, 52‑tonne, 400‑450 km low‑Earth orbit.
Estimated cost ₹1,763 crore, five modules planned, crew of 3‑4 astronauts for 3‑6 month stays, part of ISRO’s Gaganyaan human‑spaceflight programme.

alert_news.title: India's first 100% indigenised AK-203 'Sher' rifle made, test‑fired at factory in UP's Amethi
bullets: India’s first 100% indigenised AK‑203 ‘Sher’ rifle manufactured and test‑fired at Indo‑Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) factory in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.
All components sourced from Indian industry under a ₹5,200 crore contract to supply 6,01,427 rifles to the Indian Army by 2032.

alert_news.title: VP Radhakrishnan to launch India’s first non‑GMO high‑expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed
bullets: India’s first non‑GMO high‑expansion popcorn maize hybrid seed launched by Vice President CP Radhakrishnan in Musunuru village, Eluru district, Andhra Pradesh.
The seed is a hybrid variety designed for popcorn production, marking the first non‑GMO high‑expansion maize variety released in India.

alert_news.title: AssamSAT moves closer to implementation as partner selection enters final stage
bullets: AssamSAT, India’s first state‑led Earth Observation satellite system, is being implemented under the DBLOTT (Design, Build, Launch, Operate, Train and Transfer) model by the Assam government.
The satellite system will provide Earth observation data for evidence‑based governance and development planning across the state.

alert_news.title: India's first private rocket launch
bullets: Skyroot Aerospace launched India's first private rocket on 18 July 2026, deploying satellites into orbit.
Skyroot, India's first space‑tech unicorn, achieved this milestone.
